posts.title: FAJIM Medicare Foundation Scholars Programme 2026/2027
posts.summary: Financial support and mentorship for 200-level healthcare students in Nigerian public universities. Closes 11 October.
posts.body:
The FAJIM Scholars Programme gives financial support, mentorship and professional development to undergraduate students preparing for healthcare careers in Nigerian public universities.

## Who can apply (new applicants)

- Students in **200 level** at a Nigerian **public** university
- Students of Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Radiography or Medical Laboratory Science
- A CGPA of 5.00 on a 5-point scale, or an equivalent result accepted by the FAJIM Scholarship Committee
- Applicants with genuine financial need who are willing to join mentorship, health education and community service activities

Volunteering experience helps but is not required.

## What you get

- Financial assistance towards your education expenses
- Mentorship, academic guidance and professional development
- Opportunities in health education and community service

## Documents to upload

- A recent passport photograph with a **white background**
- Your current course registration record, or an official letter confirming your enrolment and level
- Your latest transcript or statement of results (Direct Entry students should upload their entry qualification results)
- One signed recommendation letter from your Faculty Dean, Sub-Dean or Head of Department, addressed to *The Scholarship Committee, FAJIM Medicare Foundation*

## How to apply

Use the **Apply now** button to open the new-applicant form, complete it and upload your documents. Applications run from 5 to 11 October 2026 and close at **11:59 p.m. WAT on 11 October 2026**. Only shortlisted applicants are contacted.

**Current FAJIM scholars:** do not use the new-applicant form. Wait for the renewal form shared in the official FAJIM Scholars' WhatsApp group.

For questions, email info@fajimmf.org.ng. Visit the [FAJIM scholarship page](https://fajimmf.org.ng/home/scholarship/) for more details.

posts.title: Decagon Undergraduate Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Full tuition for four years, plus career training and mentorship, for Nigerian students who scored at least 250 in UTME and cannot afford university.
posts.body:
The Decagon Undergraduate Scholarship (part of the Decagon Honors Program) is run by the Decagon Foundation. It supports exceptional young Nigerians who have the ability to attend university but not the means to pay for it.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian citizens currently living in Nigeria
- Applicants who scored **250 or above in UTME**
- Students who cannot independently fund a university education
- Applicants who are applying for, or already hold an offer for, an undergraduate programme at a Nigerian university. All courses are eligible

## What you get

- **Full tuition** for four years. Fees are paid directly to your school each semester after verified enrolment, not given to you as cash
- A four-year online **career accelerator** (professionalism, critical thinking, business writing, project management and ethical AI) plus one specialisation: Tech, Design, Growth Marketing or Entrepreneurship
- Structured **mentorship** from professionals in Nigeria's business and technology community
- Access to an opportunities portal with internships, vacation jobs, freelance and volunteer roles
- Leadership training from Year 1, and entry into the Decagon Honours community from Year 3

## Documents to prepare

- JAMB result slip and a passport photograph
- State of origin certificate and NIN slip (or NIMC printout)
- School leaving certificate or testimonial
- Birth certificate or declaration of age
- WAEC or NECO result or certificate

## How to apply

Use the **Apply now** button to reach the official Decagon Foundation page for students, complete the application and upload your documents before **15 October 2026**.

posts.title: Segun Idowu Memorial Foundation Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: A ₦1 million scholarship fund for Nigerian junior and senior secondary school students with strong grades, financial need and good character.
posts.body:
The Segun Idowu Memorial Foundation Scholarship supports outstanding secondary school students across Nigeria. Unlike many scholarships, it is open to students in both junior and senior secondary school.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian Junior Secondary School (JSS) or Senior Secondary School (SSS) students
- A **cumulative academic average of 85% or higher** in the last academic session
- Genuine financial need
- Good character and integrity
- Leadership potential and a positive contribution to your school or community

## About the award

The foundation offers a **₦1 million scholarship fund**. The published information does not say how the fund will be shared among successful students, so check the official application page for details. It is not described as covering every school and living cost.

University students and primary school pupils are not eligible.

## How to apply

Use the **Apply now** button to open the foundation's application form. Fill it in with accurate personal, academic and school information, add any information it asks for, and submit before **15 October 2026**. Have your last session's results ready before you start, and do not leave it to the last day.

posts.title: UBA Foundation National Essay Competition 2026
posts.summary: Nigerian senior secondary school students can win university grants of up to ₦15 million by writing on food security.
posts.body:
The National Essay Competition (NEC) is part of the UBA Foundation's education initiative. It promotes a reading culture and healthy intellectual competition among secondary school students in Nigeria and across Africa.

## Essay topic

*No Nation Can Develop Without Food Security. How Can Nigeria Deal With This Problem?*

## Who can apply

- Nigerian senior secondary school students

## What to submit

- A **handwritten** essay of not more than 750 words (not typed). Write your full name on the essay before uploading
- A recent passport photograph
- A scanned copy of your birth certificate, National ID or international passport
- Name each attachment with your name and the document, for example *John Doe – Passport Photograph*

Incomplete or duplicate entries are disqualified.

## How the competition works

1. **Stage 1:** call for entries, and the 20 best essays are selected
2. **Stage 2:** the 20 finalists sit a final physical test at the UBA Head Office in Lagos, and five winners are chosen

## Prizes (university grants)

- 1st place: ₦15 million
- 2nd place: ₦10 million
- 3rd place: ₦7.5 million
- 4th place: ₦5 million
- 5th place: ₦3.5 million

## How to apply

Use the **Apply now** button to open the official entry form. You can read more on the [UBA Foundation National Essay Competition page](https://www.ubagroup.com/our-impact/uba-foundation/national-essay-competition/).

posts.title: AMIR Fund Medical Scholars Programme 2026/2027
posts.summary: Up to 20 full-tuition scholarships for Muslim MBBS and BDS students from low-income households at selected Nigerian government universities.
posts.body:
The AMIR Fund for Education, Science and Technology offers up to 20 tuition scholarships to able Muslim medical and dental students from low-income households. Awards can be renewed each year until graduation.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian Muslim students from low-income households who can show financial need
- Students of **MBBS or BDS** in **200 level or above**
- A minimum CGPA of 3.50 on a 5.00 scale
- Students at one of these universities: UI, UNILAG, OAU, ABU, BUK, UNILORIN, UNN, UNIBEN, the Federal University of Medical Sciences Abeokuta, LASU or OOU

## What you get

- 100% of tuition and mandatory school fees, paid directly to your university
- Renewal every year until graduation, as long as you keep a CGPA of at least 3.50

## How to apply

Read the **Applicant Information Brief** on the official page before you begin, and keep your documents ready to upload. The form takes about 25 minutes. Use the **Apply now** button, and submit before **11:59 p.m. WAT on Friday, 30 October 2026**.

The application is completely free. The fund says it never asks for payment and works with no agents.

For questions, email fund@amirfund.org.

posts.title: POHER 2027 Scholars' Program for Medical Students in Africa
posts.summary: A research and career mentorship programme for medical students in African medical schools. It does not pay tuition.
posts.body:
The Pan-African Organization for Health, Education and Research (POHER) Scholars' Program is a research mentorship programme for medical students across Africa. It introduces scholars to scientific research, offers career guidance and connects them with mentors and peers.

> **Important:** This is a mentorship programme, **not** a medical school scholarship. POHER does not pay tuition.

## Who can apply

- Students currently enrolled in an African medical school (MD, MBBS, MBChB or equivalent)
- Expected graduation date **after January 2028**
- Applicants interested in research who can show leadership potential and are motivated to receive mentorship
- Students who can take part actively through the year, including virtual work-in-progress meetings and POHER webinars

Prior research experience is **not** required.

## What you get

- Research mentorship and career guidance
- Introduction to the principles of scientific research
- Guidance on conference attendance, abstracts and manuscripts
- Networking with medical students, researchers and mentors across Africa
- Access to online global health and career-related courses
- Leadership opportunities, including helping organise the POHER Annual Medical Research and Mentorship Symposium

## How to apply

Applications opened on 1 October 2026 and close on **31 October 2026**. Use the **Apply now** button to open the online application form. You will be asked about your medical school, expected graduation date, research interests, leadership experience and why you want to join.

For questions, email pohersocialmedia@gmail.com.

posts.title: Punocracy Prize for Satire 2026
posts.summary: Young Nigerian writers aged 15 to 30 can win up to ₦350,000 for a piece of satire on society, politics or nation-building.
posts.body:
Punocracy is a community of young Nigerian writers of satire. The Prize for Satire, now in its fourth edition, gives young writers a platform to use wit, irony and humour to comment on society, politics and nation-building.

## Who can apply

- Young Nigerian writers who will be **between 15 and 30 years old as of December 2026**
- This is an age-based competition, so students at any level can enter

## Rules to note

- Satire means writing that uses wit, irony, sarcasm or ridicule to criticise faults
- **Entries generated with a large language model (AI) are not eligible**
- Longlisted entries are published on the Punocracy website, and winners are announced before the end of 2026

## Prizes

- 1st prize: ₦350,000
- 2nd prize: ₦200,000
- 3rd prize: ₦150,000

## How to apply

The deadline is **11:59 p.m. on Saturday, 31 October 2026**. Use the **Apply now** button to open the Punocracy website, and follow the call for entries there for the submission details. You can also email hello@punocracy.com with questions.

posts.title: Prince Ukeme Ukpong Mega Foundation Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Two-year tuition support for students of Akwa Ibom State origin who are enrolled in a Nigerian tertiary institution.
posts.body:
The Prince Ukeme Ukpong Education Support Scholarship is an initiative of the Prince Ukeme Ukpong Mega Foundation. It gives selected students two years of tuition support to ease the financial burden of tertiary education.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian citizens of Akwa Ibom State origin
- Students currently enrolled in a Nigerian tertiary institution (university, polytechnic, college of education or similar)
- Applicants who can show genuine financial need and a commitment to completing their education

No particular school is required. A qualified Akwa Ibom indigene studying anywhere in Nigeria can apply.

## What you get

- Tuition support for two years
- Winners receive their awards at the foundation's annual *Learn, Excel and Empower* programme in Akwa Ibom State

## How to apply

Apply through the foundation's online application form using the **Apply now** button. The foundation states that the application is free, and applicants should never pay an agent or processing fee.

## Important note

Meeting the requirements does not guarantee selection. All applicants go through the foundation's selection process.

posts.title: Carewave ASPIRE Scholarship Programme 2026
posts.summary: ₦500,000 per year for academically strong Nigerian students with financial need who have been admitted into an eligible Federal University.
posts.body:
The Carewave ASPIRE Scholarship Programme (CASP) is run by the Carewave Foundation to help academically talented but financially disadvantaged Nigerian students stay in tertiary education.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian citizens who have secured admission into an eligible Federal University
- Undergraduates aged 18 to 25 with a minimum GPA of 4.5 on a 5.0 scale
- Applicants who can show strong academic performance, genuine financial need, integrity and leadership potential
- Priority is given to students from vulnerable or financially disadvantaged backgrounds

The programme covers a wide range of courses, including health and medical sciences, technology, engineering, law, economics and other humanities and social sciences. Check the official page for the full list.

## What you get

- ₦500,000 per year
- The first award covers one academic year. It can be renewed if you stay in good academic standing and meet the programme conditions
- Mentorship and scholar activities organised by Carewave

## Documents to prepare

- Admission letter, JAMB admission letter and JAMB result slip
- WAEC or NECO result, birth certificate, Local Government identification and NIMC slip
- Two letters of recommendation and a motivational letter
- Proof of financial need (for example, a guardian's payslip, household income evidence or a letter from a recognised community or religious leader)

## How to apply

Apply online through the Carewave Foundation scholarship platform using the **Apply now** button. Create or update your profile, select the programme, complete the form and upload all documents before you submit. Incomplete applications may not be considered. IELTS is not required.

posts.title: The ICON Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Tuition support from White Avenue Group for newly admitted Nigerian university students from all 36 states and the FCT.
posts.body:
The ICON Scholarship is offered by White Avenue Group as part of its commitment to education and community development. It supports students who are just beginning university.

## Who can apply

- Nigerian students who are **newly admitted** into a Nigerian university and hold a valid admission
- Students from any of the 36 states or the FCT

## What you get

Tuition support. The announcement does **not** state an amount, so ask the scholarship team if you need clarity.

## Documents to prepare

- A valid means of identification
- Your university admission letter
- WAEC or NECO result
- JAMB result
- Birth certificate
- A cover letter

## How to apply

Use the **Apply now** button to open the online application form, fill it in accurately and upload your documents before **15 November 2026**. The application is free.

For questions about eligibility, the amount or the selection process, email iconscholarship@whiteavenuemail.com.

posts.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program 2027/28 – University of Edinburgh
posts.summary: Fully funded one-year master's or postgraduate diploma at the University of Edinburgh for young African leaders, with a focus on climate justice. Invitation-only this year.
posts.body:
The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Edinburgh funds postgraduate study for exceptional young Africans who have shown leadership, overcome barriers to education and want to make a positive impact, particularly on climate and sustainability.

## Important: new application process for 2027/28

Edinburgh changed the process this year:

- Applicants had to attend a **mandatory virtual information session held between 15 and 24 September 2026** to be considered
- Eligible attendees learn on **13 October 2026** whether they have been invited to apply
- Invited applicants complete a short first stage, then the **Scholarship Main Application, which closes on 19 November 2026 at 5:00 p.m. UK time**
- Do **not** apply for your degree programme first. The scholarship application comes first, and awardees (announced March 2027) are then invited to apply for their programme

If you did not attend an information session, check the official page to see whether any route is still open before you spend time on this.

## What it covers

- Full funding for a one-year on-campus master's degree or an online postgraduate diploma
- Participation in the wider Climate Leadership Programme, including online workshops, coaching and support

## Who can apply

- African applicants who will have completed an undergraduate degree by 19 November 2026
- Candidates who have faced significant barriers to education or early career opportunities
- Applicants who show leadership, community service and a commitment to creating positive impact
- Applicants who qualify academically for admission to one of the eligible Edinburgh programmes (generally a UK 2:1 equivalent or higher)

## How to apply

Read the full process and the list of eligible programmes on the official Edinburgh page using the **Apply now** button.

posts.title: Pro. Dr. Gabriel Olubunmi Fakeye Scholarship & Bursary Award 2027
posts.summary: ₦300,000 scholarships and ₦100,000 bursaries for indigent members of the Cherubim & Seraphim Movement Church, Surulere District, studying in Nigerian public institutions.
posts.body:
The Pro. Dr. Gabriel Olubunmi Fakeye (GOF) Scholarship & Bursary Award is offered by the Cherubim & Seraphim Movement Church, Surulere District Headquarters, Lagos. It supports dedicated church members in their undergraduate studies.

## Who can apply

- Indigent members of the Cherubim & Seraphim Movement Church, Surulere District and its branches
- Undergraduates at a Nigerian public tertiary institution
- For the **Scholarship Award**: a minimum CGPA of 3.5
- For the **Bursary Award**: a minimum CGPA of 3.0

## Awards

- **Scholarship:** ₦300,000 each for 2 beneficiaries
- **Bursary:** ₦100,000 each for 40 beneficiaries

## Documents to upload

- Admission letter
- Your latest academic result showing your current CGPA, signed by an authorised officer of your institution
- A recommendation letter from your Branch Leader. If you cannot get one, state the reason in the application
- A passport photograph

Result, admission and recommendation files can be PDF, DOC or DOCX. The photograph can be JPG, JPEG or PNG. Each file must be 5 MB or less.

## How the selection works

1. Create your profile, complete the form, upload your documents and submit
2. Documents are verified and screened
3. Shortlisted candidates take an examination and attend an interview
4. Approved awards are paid directly to the bank account you provide

## How to apply

Applications opened on 4 October 2026 and close on **4 December 2026**. Use the **Apply now** button to reach the official application portal.

posts.title: Bode Amao Foundation Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Full tuition support plus a ₦100,000 annual stipend for academically strong but indigent Nigerian university students (200 level and above).
posts.body:
The Bode Amao Foundation (BAF) Scholarship supports academically strong Nigerian undergraduates who cannot afford the cost of university education. Beneficiaries can keep the award throughout their course of study as long as they maintain the required academic standard.

## Who can apply

- Registered students of Nigerian universities who are **at least in 200 level** when they complete the form
- Applicants with strong academic performance (CGPA is an important factor)
- Students who can prove financial need. The university Registrar must certify that the applicant is indigent
- Open to Nigerians regardless of tribe, sex, religion or age

## What you get

- Full tuition support
- ₦100,000 stipend for each academic year
- Continued support for the rest of your course, subject to academic excellence

## Documents to prepare

- Completed application form and academic transcript
- Letters of recommendation from higher authorities
- University student ID card, plus a Local Government Area letter of identification
- Original medical certificate (including HIV test document)
- JAMB admission letter, university admission letter and course registration form

## How to apply

Download and print the application form from the foundation's official website using the **Apply now** button, fill it in, attach the documents above and get it attested by your university Registrar. Submit only one application. False information leads to automatic disqualification.

Completed forms can be sent by email to the addresses on the foundation's official page, or by post to: Bode Amao Foundation (BAF), P.O. Box 7088, Secretariat Post Office, Ibadan, Oyo State.

IELTS is not required.

posts.title: ARSO 14th Continental Essay Competition 2026/2027
posts.summary: African tertiary students under 35 can win up to US$1,000 by writing on intra-African trade, conformity assessment and the cotton-to-clothing value chain.
posts.body:
The African Organisation for Standardisation (ARSO) has opened entries for its 14th Continental Essay Competition. Students explore practical solutions that can strengthen trade between African countries.

## Essay theme

*Advancing Intra-African Trade through Conformity Assessment and Mutual Recognition Agreements (MRAs): Unlocking the Full Potential of the Cotton-to-Clothing Value Chain under the AfCFTA.*

## Who can apply

- Citizens or residents of a participating African country
- Undergraduate or postgraduate students at a recognised tertiary institution, in any discipline
- Applicants under 35 years old
- One original, unpublished entry per person

## Essay requirements

- 1,000 to 1,200 words (not counting references and author details), in English or French
- Century Gothic, size 12, double-spaced
- Submitted as a PDF or Word (.docx) file
- No plagiarism and no AI-generated content. Such entries are disqualified

## What to submit

- The completed ARSO registration form (download it from the official page)
- A copy of your student ID card or passport
- Your essay

Send these through your country's National Standards Body or the country-specific email listed on the official page. In Nigeria the national standards body is the Standards Organisation of Nigeria.

## Prizes

- 1st place: US$1,000, a certificate and travel sponsorship to the 33rd ARSO General Assembly
- 2nd place: US$800 and a certificate
- 3rd place: US$500 and a certificate
- National winners receive certificates and prizes from their national bodies

## Important dates

- **3 September 2026:** call for entries opened
- **23 April 2027:** last day for participating countries to send their selected entries to ARSO
- **July 2027:** continental winners announced

**Your national body will set an earlier cut-off than ARSO's.** Confirm it on the official page or with your national standards body, and do not wait until April.
